kv13.8:1.3: Dukkhābhinandino sattā atthi keci dukkhaṃ patthenti pihenti esanti gavesanti pariyesanti dukkhaṃ ajjhosāya tiṭṭhantīti?
kv13.8:1.5: Nanu sukhābhinnandino sattā atthi keci sukhaṃ patthenti pihenti esanti gavesanti pariyesanti sukhaṃ ajjhosāya tiṭṭhantīti?
kv13.8:1.7: Hañci sukhābhinandino --pe-- tiṭṭhanti, no vata re vattabbe
kv13.8:2.3: Dukkhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, sukhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anusetīti?
kv13.8:2.5: Nanu sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anusetīti?
kv13.8:2.7: Hañci sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anuseti, no vata re vattabbe
kv13.8:3.5: "So evaṃ anurodhavirodhaṃ samāpanno yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vediyati, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhatīti."
